g.text: Synthetic region-days: five magnetogram-like features driven by a hidden free-energy variable; flare (M class or above within 24
h) drawn from a logistic law with an unobserved trigger term. First 60 % for training, last 40 % for testing. (c) Fixed detection
and false-alarm rates of the logistic model.
